mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE id = #{id} AND pw = #{pw};
SELECT m.id, m.email, MAX(l.logindate) AS last_login FROM member m JOIN login_history l ON m.id = l.id GROUP BY m.id, m.email HAVING last_login < NOW() - INTERVAL 1 YEAR;
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET active = "OFF" WHERE id = #{id};
